blocker: 来源下拉有两个同名behavior_log，尚不能可靠识别好友房资产；不按顺序猜选。
boundaries: 21条原标准定义映射到6个核心候选，不是新增21项。
event_group是SQL内固定业务分组，不是新建平台分类或业务过程。
同一事件可能同时属于success、participation等分组；查询必须明确分组，不合计分组结果。
分组内UV使用COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)；跨日期或分组UV需从原始明细重算。
入口或渠道下钻需在同一原始事件集合重新聚合，本稿未预聚合这些维度。
两项占比须重算分子分母，不平均日比例；缺数据不补0。
本稿SQL未执行生产取数，待绑定后验收；未创建物理中间表。

metrics.name: 好友房｜祈福分组行为次数
metrics.definition: 指定event_group内按事件记录行计数。每个分组对应固定事件集合；曝光、点击、成功、参与分别筛选，不把各分组相加。账号数跨事件、渠道或日期汇总须从原明细重算。
metrics.sql:
WITH event_map AS (
 SELECT 'success' AS event_group,'use_quick_pray_lucky_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'success' AS event_group,'use_game_pray_lucky_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'success' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_use_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'game_pray_lucky_icon_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'quick_pray_lucky_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'use_quick_pray_lucky_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_human_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_use_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'participation' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_purchase_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'purchase' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_purchase_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'quick_success' AS event_group,'use_quick_pray_lucky_success' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'quick_free' AS event_group,'use_quick_pray_lucky_success' AS event_id,1 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'exposure_game' AS event_group,'game_pray_lucky_icon_show' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'exposure_quick' AS event_group,'quick_pray_lucky_show' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'exposure_human' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_human_exposure' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'click_game' AS event_group,'game_pray_lucky_icon_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'click_quick' AS event_group,'quick_pray_lucky_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'click_human' AS event_group,'pray_lucky_human_click' AS event_id,0 AS free_only
)
SELECT DATE(b.log_date) AS dt,m.event_group,COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.behavior_log b
JOIN event_map m ON b.event_id=m.event_id AND (m.free_only=0 OR b.temp_c='free')
WHERE b.log_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND b.log_date<CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY DATE(b.log_date),m.event_group;

metrics.name: 好友房｜快速祈福免费占比
metrics.definition: 同一窗口内use_quick_pray_lucky_success中temp_c=free的记录数／该事件全部记录数；空值及其他编码不擅自判断为付费。分母为0返回NULL。
metrics.sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(CASE WHEN temp_c='free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.behavior_log
WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE()
 AND event_id='use_quick_pray_lucky_success'
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);
metrics.status: 已收敛草案；未录入，待可靠来源绑定及生产验收

metrics.name: 好友房｜求签免费占比

metrics.sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_id='draw_lots_free_success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.behavior_log
WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE()
 AND event_id IN ('draw_lots_free_success','draw_lots_cost_success')
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);
